note: SMAD2 missense variants in the MH2 domain are frequently linked to aneurysms/dissections, mirroring findings in homologous SMAD3 where MH2 dominant-negative mutations confer higher vascular event risks than haploinsufficiency.

evidence.text: In a study evaluating pathogenic SMAD2 variants, novel variants associated with arterial aneurysms and dissections included four missense variants located in the functionally important MH2 domain and one nonsense variant.

source.title: Novel pathogenic SMAD2 variants in five families with arterial aneurysm and dissection: further delineation of the phenotype
source.quote: novel SMAD2 (likely) pathogenic variants: four missense variants in … ally important MH2 domain and one nonsense variant.

evidence.text: Investigation of SMAD2 variants observed distinct phenotypic outcomes where truncating and missense variants presented with complex CHD or late-onset vascular phenotypes including aneurysms and dissections, highlighting genotype-phenotype correlations across functional domains.

source.title: Variable cardiovascular phenotypes associated with SMAD2 pathogenic variants
